observations.rationale: Manual VIN creation in Excel creates significant process bottleneck with high error potential and capacity constraints in critical value stream stage

evidence.excerpt: VIN Number Creation handled manually in Excel as transitional solution (intensity 8/10, stage: Customer Order Fulfillment → VIN Assignment) ← rep flagged as binding

observations.rationale: Manual Vehicle Delivery Order creation for Volvo Coach orders creates handoff delays and rework potential between order registration and downstream processes

evidence.excerpt: Manual Vehicle Delivery Order creation required for Volvo Coach orders (intensity 7/10, stage: Customer Order Fulfillment → Order Registration)

observations.rationale: Complex replication of product configuration data from SAP Prevost to BM creates data fragmentation and decision latency in configuration process

evidence.excerpt: Complex product configuration replication from SAP Prevost to BM including variants, rules and restrictions (intensity 6/10, stage: Customer Order Fulfillment → Product Configuration)

bindingConstraint.justification: VIN Assignment represents the highest-scoring constraint with maximum downstream dependency - all subsequent order processing stages depend on VIN completion, creating systemic bottleneck effect amplified by manual Excel-based process

constraintScoring.selectionRationale: Highest total score (12/15) with maximum capacity constraint and downstream dependency impact
